name: NEXTDC S3 Sydney Artarmon
notes: NEXTDC lists S3 as an 80MW Tier IV certified data centre in Artarmon. NSW planning assessment records the approved eight-storey data centre at 2 Broadcast Way, Artarmon, operating 24/7.

name: NEXTDC S6 Sydney Artarmon AI Factory
notes: NEXTDC lists S6 Sydney in Artarmon, adjacent to S3, as a 13.5MW purpose-built data centre for AI factory and sovereign AI workloads.

name: Cloud Carrier Southern Highlands Data Campus
notes: Cloud Carrier describes a 67-hectare Southern Highlands Data Campus with DB1 and DB2 coming soon, scalable powered-shell infrastructure, and onsite power of several hundred MW. ABC reported Nakar Property/Cloud Carrier wants gas-fired power stations totalling more than 700MW to run an existing data centre and two planned data centres near Moss Vale; IT capacity was not stated.

name: Equinix SY7 Wollongong / Unanderra
notes: Equinix lists SY7 at Wollongong NSW 2526 with 16,286 sq ft of data centre space and N+1 power redundancy; DataCenterMap places SY7 at Lot 102 Lathe Place, Unanderra.

name: Energy North Project Ares Murranji Station
notes: Energy North says Project Ares is a proposed hyperscale digital infrastructure campus at Murranji Station in the Barkly Region, with dedicated solar, battery and gas-fired power. ABC and trade sources report a 1GW data centre campus, about 90 hectares of data halls, and environmental referrals under assessment.
